scenarios.name: Join panels in one dock region as selectable tabs

scenario_steps.name: two dockable panels are open in separate workspace regions
the user drags one panel onto the center of the other panel's dock region
the destination region indicates a tab insertion target
the user releases the panel over that target
both panels occupy the same dock region as tabs
one panel is active while the other remains available
the user selects the other panel tab
its contents replace the active panel contents in that region
the viewport and active document remain available
